CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) +
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1

  CFDLean.Roe.B γ z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(2 * z 0) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0,
        z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1,
        z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2,

        (1 / γ) •
          (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
            (γ - 1) •
              (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))]

CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1.type:

        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +

        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +

        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +

        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (bas : Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c =
              ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen.type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u =
    ↑((γ - 1) •
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
            (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
              u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
          (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3), γ - 1 ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.energy γ) = 1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v) =

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n) = 0
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c =
    (1 / (2 * c ^ 2)) • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2 - c • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c) v =
          (((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v - c * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) / (2 * c ^ 2)) •
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n (-c)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_apply

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c) =
          Submodule.span ℝ {CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n (-c)}
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus_range

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1.type:
∀ (c s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c s j =
    ![(s ^ 2 - c * s) / (2 * c ^ 2), 1 - s ^ 2 / c ^ 2, (s ^ 2 + c * s) / (2 * c ^ 2)] j
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset.type:
∀ (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i) j = if i = j then 1 else 0
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier_offset

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_10.type: ∀ (n t s : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (t + s) n = CFDLean.dot t n + CFDLean.dot s n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_11.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (r : ℝ) (t : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (r • t) n = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • CFDLean.dot t n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_11.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal._proof_11

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal_surjective.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Function.Surjective ⇑(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.normal n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i = ![-c, 0, c] i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c =
    (1 / (2 * c ^ 2)) • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2 + c • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c) v =
          (((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v + c * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) / (2 * c ^ 2)) •
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n c
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_apply

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),

    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c) = Submodule.span ℝ {CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n c}
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus_range

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Fin 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i =
    ![CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c] i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i * CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j =
            if i = j then CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i else 0
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_algebra

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c s : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v = s • v →
    ∀ (j : Fin 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j) v = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.multiplier c s j • v
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_eigen

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i • v →
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c j) v = if i = j then v else 0
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_on_shift_eigen

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range.type:

    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 3),
          LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) =
            (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_range

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H (-n) c i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i.rev
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),

    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c = 1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.type:
∀ (f : Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (r : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (a : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → ℝ),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1.type:

      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift

∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y) n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n =
                ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (μ : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
            v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v = μ • v → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v = |μ| • v
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (-n) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5),
              ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i • bas j
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
      ∀ (tb : Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ
            ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)} ∪
              Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ↑(tb i)) =
          Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tangent_span

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ^ 3 =
            CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ
                ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          (∀ (s : ℝ),
              s = -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∨ s = CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) =
                  (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n + s) •
                    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) ∧
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) =
                CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ∧
              ∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
                CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
                  (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t) =
                    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i * CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n j =
              if i = j then CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i else 0
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algebra

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) =
              Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranges

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ ↥(LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i)) = ![1, 3, 1] i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y (-n) i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i.rev
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2 =
          1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) =
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 +
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomposition

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (-n) i = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.type: ∀ (u t : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t = ![0, t 0, t 1, t 2, CFDLean.dot u t]
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_13.type:
∀ (u t s : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (t + s) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u s
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_13.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_13

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_14.type:
∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (r : ℝ) (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (r • t) = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_14.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_14

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t) = CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n - CFDLean.dot u n • 1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v =
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v) =
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2) v =
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
            (c ^ 2 * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    s ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s) =
        s • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 3 = c ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∧
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 =
            (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n =
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c +
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c +
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposition

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero

∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),

CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.type: ∀ (r : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.assemble r = ContinuousLinearMap.pi r
CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.name: CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi

CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ y
CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y i =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (p : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates × CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < p.1 0 →
    0 < p.2 0 → ContinuousAt (fun q => (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity q.1 q.2, CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ q.1 q.2)) p
CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt

CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x
CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal

CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y
CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap

CFDLean.Roe.embed.eq_1.type: ∀ (i : Fin 5), CFDLean.Roe.embed i = ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j => if j = i then ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ else 0
CFDLean.Roe.embed.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.embed.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x = γ * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x / x 0
CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.endpoint_thermal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) =
      CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x
CFDLean.Roe.endpoint_thermal.name: CFDLean.Roe.endpoint_thermal

CFDLean.Roe.enthalpy_continuousAt.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), x 0 ≠ 0 → ContinuousAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ) x
CFDLean.Roe.enthalpy_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.enthalpy_continuousAt

CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n t - CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n z =
    (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n fun i => (z i + t i) / 2) (t - z)
CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump.name: CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump

CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_diagonal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) n))
      (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x x n) x
CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_diagonal

CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterFlux.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n) (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z) z
CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterFlux.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterFlux

CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterPressur.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ) (CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z) z
CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterPressur.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterPressure

CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterState.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ) (CFDLean.Roe.B γ z) z
CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterState.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterState

CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S • CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x) =
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x
CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant.name: CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant

CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ z =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![(1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0,
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 - z 1 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 - z 2 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 - z 3 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        (1 / z 0) •
          (γ • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 - z 4 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 -
            (γ - 1) •
              (z 1 •
                    (1 / z 0) •
                      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 -
                        z 1 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
                  z 2 •
                    (1 / z 0) •
                      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 -
                        z 2 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
                z 3 •
                  (1 / z 0) •
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 -
                      z 3 • (1 / (2 * z 0)) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)))]
CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.inverseB.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.inverseB_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 → z 0 ≠ 0 → ∀ (v : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), (CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ z) ((CFDLean.Roe.B γ z) v) = v
CFDLean.Roe.inverseB_B.name: CFDLean.Roe.inverseB_B

CFDLean.Roe.midpoint.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 5),
  CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y i = (CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x i + CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ y i) / 2
CFDLean.Roe.midpoint.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.midpoint.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_enthalpy.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 → 0 < y 0 → CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y 4 / CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y 0 = CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y
CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_enthalpy.name: CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_enthalpy

CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_pos.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates), 0 < x 0 → 0 < y 0 → 0 < CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y 0
CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_pos.name: CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_pos

CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_velocity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      (fun i => CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y ↑↑i.succ / CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y 0) = CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y
CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_velocity.name: CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_velocity

CFDLean.Roe.operator.type:
ℝ →
  CFDLean.Vector 3 →
    ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates
CFDLean.Roe.operator.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator

CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n =
    CFDLean.Roe.assemble
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            u 0 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 0 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            u 1 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 1 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            u 2 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 2 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
              (γ - 1) •
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                    (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                      u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                  (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)) +
          H • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)]
CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    z 0 ≠ 0 →
      (CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (fun i => z ↑↑i.succ / z 0) (z 4 / z 0) n).comp (CFDLean.Roe.B γ z) = CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z
CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_B

CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), Continuous fun p => CFDLean.Roe.operator γ p.1 p.2 n
CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_continuous

CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x) n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n
CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_physical

CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H a : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H fun i => a * n i) = a • CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n
CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_smul

CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x =
    ![CFDLean.Roe.root x, CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2,
      CFDLean.Roe.root x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x]
CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n z =
    ![z 0 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z,
      z 1 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 0,
      z 2 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 1,
      z 3 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z + CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z * n 2,
      z 4 * (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z]
CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure γ z = (γ - 1) / γ * (z 0 * z 4 - (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 + z 3 ^ 2) / 2)
CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterPressure.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ z =
    ![z 0 ^ 2, z 0 * z 1, z 0 * z 2, z 0 * z 3, (z 0 * z 4 + (γ - 1) / 2 * (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 + z 3 ^ 2)) / γ]
CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameterState.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    0 < x 0 → CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n (CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x) = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n x
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux

CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 → 0 < x 0 → CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ (CFDLean.Roe.parameter γ x) = x
CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state

CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z =
    ((γ - 1) / γ) •
      (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
        (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
          z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))
CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix.type:
ℝ →
  CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →
    CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →
      CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    0 < x 0 →
      0 < y 0 →
        (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).comp (CFDLean.Roe.B γ (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y)) =
          CFDLean.Roe.C γ n (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y)
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n =
          (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y)).comp (CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ (CFDLean.Roe.midpoint γ x y))
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (p : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates × CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < p.1 0 → 0 < p.2 0 → ContinuousAt (fun q => CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ q.1 q.2 n) p
CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousAt

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousOn.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ContinuousOn (fun q => CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ q.1 q.2 n)
    {p |
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode p.1) ∧
        CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode p.2)}

CFDLean.Roe.secant_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
    (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare_pos.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ t - CFDLean.Roe.parameterState γ z = (CFDLean.Roe.B γ fun i => (z i + t i) / 2) (t - z)

CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
        CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x +
            CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y +
          (γ - 1) / 2 * CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.weight y x *
            CFDLean.squareSum fun i => CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i
CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.name: CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity

      a * CFDLean.squareSum v + b * CFDLean.squareSum w - a * b * CFDLean.squareSum fun i => w i - v i

CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S =
    { density := CFDLean.dot U.momentum S,
      momentum := fun i =>
        U.momentum i * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * S i,
      energy := (U.energy + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) }
CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1

CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => S i + T i) =
    { density := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).density,
      momentum := fun i => (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).momentum i,
      energy := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_add

CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.type:

    { density := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density,
      momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i,
      energy := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul

CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse.type:

CFDLean.physicalFlux_zero.type:
